description: Post what a buyer needs when search finds nothing, so sellers can quote them. No sign-in required. A signed-in buyer can omit email. An anonymous caller passes buyer_email. This saves the request. It does not send an email.

buyer_email.description: Required when the caller is not signed in. Where a seller can reply.

quantity.description: How many units they want. Optional.

query.description: What the buyer wants, in their words. `what` and `q` are accepted as aliases.

name: post_wanted_request
title: Post a wanted request
